searchText: Speaking of the last call, it seemed we still lack consensus on transaction pool rules for blob transactions. I wrote up this doc to try and outline the approaches and eventually capture what the various implementations have chosen to do. Can the EL client teams take a look and comment / provide details on their implementations? Thanks! https://hackmd.io/aVek93y-QmSv1mz2Agc9iQ <gakonst> Added <@806184091690598420> from reth who will be working on 4844 starting next week
